lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Under a pile of rusty keys, something small and silver glints: a badge shaped like a bell.

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: Her name is on it. And a tiny drawing of her... with a lot more hair.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: On the back, in small scratchy letters, someone carved a promise.

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: Even if it's hard, don't give up.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: She used to be a hero. A real one.

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: She still is! And she makes the best tea in nine realms.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: What do you do with the badge?

choices.en: Hide it and keep it a secret.

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: No secrets from Granny! ...But we can make it a surprise.

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: We must give it back to her!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: You tuck the badge safely into your pack. It feels warm, like a cup of Granny Bai's tea.
